title: MIR 3.3 and 2.6 host-neutral extension platform
migration_impact: Introduces MIR Extension Protocol v1 as a host-neutral, capability-negotiated, data-first protocol. MIR 3.3.x and 2.6.x share one semantic protocol while using target-specific discovery transports. The legacy compatibility-pack transport remains supported through the first complete modern and Factorio 2.0 release pair.
release_note_impact: MIR 3.3.0 and 2.6.0 require extension-protocol, SDK, compatibility-window, target-omission, fork-continuity, and migration documentation.

backport_disposition.factorio-2.1: canonical MEP-1 implementation and unique mod-data plus portable stage-bus transports in MIR 3.3.x
backport_disposition.factorio-2.0: the same MEP-1 semantic protocol projected through the stage-bus and target adapters, then independently qualified as MIR 2.6.x
